name: IBY_EXT_PARTY_PMT_MTHDS_
description: IBY_EXT_PARTY_PMT_MTHDS stores payment method applicability driven by the preferences of the external party. A payment method is applicable to a party and payment function combination and, optionally and additionally, to a party site and/or organization. This table is shared by funds capture and fund disbursement flows.

columns.name: EXT_PARTY_PMT_MTHD_ID
columns.description: System-generated primary key.

columns.name: PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Payment method Identifier

columns.name: PAYMENT_FLOW
columns.description: Specifies funds capture or disbursement flow.  Values taken from lookup: IBY_PAYMENT_FLOW

columns.name: EXT_PMT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: External party Identifier, either a payee or payer, depending on the payment flow

columns.name: PAYMENT_FUNCTION
columns.description: Function or purpose of the payment. Values from the lookup IBY_PAYMENT_FUNCTIONS include SUPPLIER_PAYMENT, CUSTOMER_REFUNDS, and others.

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if payment method is primary. Y for Yes, N otherwise.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INACTIVE_DATE
columns.description: interface.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date when an explicit assignment of a payment method to an external payee becomes active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date when an explicit assignment of a payment method to an external payee becomes inactive.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Enterprise identifier to support multi-tenancy.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_PAYMENT_TERM_ID
columns.description: Overriding payment term. Foreign key to the AP_TERMS_B table.

columns.name: BACKUP_PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Backup payment method. Foreign key to the IBY_PAYMENT_METHODS_B table.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
